reason: £280 is over a week and a half of my take-home, and I can usually find a decent used set on Marketplace for £150-200 if I'm patient and haggle. The checks and in-person viewing are good, but I'd rather save the money.
objection: Refurbished means repaired and repainted, so how do I know they're not cracked or bent underneath? A new seller with no reviews and just a photo or a balancer report isn't enough for me to spend £280 when I can get cheaper.
would_change_my_mind: Dropping to about £200 a set, or letting me see them on a balancer in person and haggle on the day.
